newsitem.title: USA: Anicom says to sell 1 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Anicom says to sell 1 million shares.

text.p: Anicom Inc said Tuesday it plans to sell one million shares of its common stock in a private placement of about $13 million.
The stock will be sold to a group of investors, including Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Co, Anicom said.
Proceeds from the private placement will be used to fund ongoing acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, Anicom said.
The company said the placement is subject to various conditions but expects it to be completed in the next two weeks.
Anicom sells and distributes multimedia technology products.
